description.value: Kwakiutl First Nation–owned riverfront resort where the Cluxewe River meets Broughton Strait, near Port McNeill on northern Vancouver Island, with 123 sites and cabins in a historically significant setting well-suited for fishing, birding, and wildlife watching. Seasonal operation (roughly May–October); washroom type and exact road surface unconfirmed.

address.value: #1 Cluxewe Campground Rd, Port McNeill, BC V0N 2R0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The kwakiutl.bc.ca/cluxewe-resort/ page confirms Cluxewe Resort is an active campground-and-cabin resort on Kwakiutl First Nation land at the Cluxewe River / Broughton Strait confluence near Port McNeill, providing a manager phone number, email, and civic address. OSM supplies capacity=123, internet_access=yes, power_supply=yes, and sanitary_dump_station=yes, but none of those tags could be corroborated by the band-council page; full amenity details reside only on the separate resort website cluxeweresort.com, which was not fetched. A current housekeeper job posting on the jobs page confirms the resort is actively operating.
concerns: The OSM URL points to the Kwakiutl Band Council page about the resort rather than the resort's own dedicated website (cluxeweresort.com); full amenity details are only available on the un-fetched cluxeweresort.com — enrichment should be re-run against that URL.
Phone ((250) 949-0378) and address (#1 Cluxewe Campground Rd, Port McNeill, BC V0N 2R0) were sourced from the website only; neither was present in OSM tags, so contact_confirmed values are null.
OSM tags internet_access=yes and power_supply=yes could not be confirmed via the band-council page; all optional amenity values remain null pending a fetch of cluxeweresort.com.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, actively operating Indigenous-owned campground and cabin resort near Port McNeill with 123 sites; a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the northern Vancouver Island corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Resort's dedicated website is cluxeweresort.com (referenced on the band-council page). Manager: Marilyn White; direct resort email: relax@cluxeweresort.com.
